哦.why: interjection 'oh, I see' is ò (ó = surprise); bare neutral 'o' is not the standard reading

铺.why: verb 'to spread out' is pū; pù is the noun 'shop'

哄.why: HSK sense is 'to coax; to humor (a child)' = hǒng; hōng is only 'roar with laughter'

淋.why: 'to pour over / get drenched' (淋雨, 淋浴) is lín; lìn is only 淋病/过滤

款式.why: 式 keeps full 4th tone (现汉: kuǎnshì)

甭.why: 甭 is béng (2nd tone), not bèng

熨.why: 'to iron clothes' (熨衣服, 熨斗) is yùn; yù only in 熨帖

出息.why: 息 is neutral tone in 出息 (现汉: chū·xi)
